subject: Orchid Health — Evaluation preflight & MAP action card (API keys, allowlist, peering)
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@orchidhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation preflight & MAP — initial questions

Thanks for the call today. A few follow-ups from our infra team so we can lock the POC start date: 

1) API keys: we need to confirm whether keys will be short-lived (ephemeral) or long-lived for the 4-week eval. Our security team prefers rotation.
2) Org setup: how do we provision our org account and tenant? Will users be invited or will you create org-level service accounts?
3) IP allowlist & peering: we plan to request an allowlist entry and a VPC peering. Can you send the specific IP ranges and peering instructions?

If possible, we want these items listed in the MAP with owners and dates. Current target kickoff: 2027-06-28.

– Alex
Alex Mercer
Director, Platform Engineering
Orchid Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation preflight & MAP — initial questions

Alex — thanks for outlining these. I created a short MAP action card below and attached a spreadsheet. Owner assignments are proposals; tell us if Orchid prefers different owners.

MAP action card (summary):
- API keys: Redwood to provision ephemeral service key + web console invite for two users. Owner: Marcus Lin. Due: 2027-06-24.
- Org setup: Redwood to create tenant and invite Orchid SRE/Dev users. Owner: Neha Kapoor. Due: 2027-06-25.
- IP allowlist: Orchid to provide CIDR list; Redwood to add and confirm reachability. Owner: Alex Mercer (input), Jonas Weber (validation). Due: 2027-06-26.
- VPC peering: Both teams to exchange peering templates and schedule a brief network runbook call. Owner: Orchid network (Priya) / Redwood infra (Jonas). Target: provision by 2027-06-27.

Next steps: please confirm owners and the two users to invite. If everything looks good we can keep 2027-06-28 as the POC kick. I've attached the MAP spreadsheet for tracking.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation preflight & MAP — initial questions

Quick tech notes from our side to include in the MAP spreadsheet and the network doc: 
- API keys: we'll issue a scoped service key with a 30-day TTL; rotation endpoint and CLI instructions are in the attachment. If Orchid wants longer-lived creds we can add a commit to rotate weekly.
- IP ranges for hosted inference endpoints (us-west-2): 52.24.160.0/20, 3.231.0.0/16 — please confirm with Priya if these can be added to your allowlist.
- VPC peering template: I attached a minimal CloudFormation snippet and a checklist: route tables, security groups, and accepted peering request. Expect 45–90 minutes to validate once we exchange details.

I'll pick up the API key provisioning task after Neha creates the tenant.

– Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: orchard-map-v1.xlsx (MAP tracking sheet), vpc-peering-snippet.yml (CFN snippet)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchidhealth.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@orchidhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation preflight & MAP — initial questions

Hannah / team — confirming network owner here. We will add the two CIDR blocks Marcus listed to our allowlist but need the exact public egress IP for the service key checkout (we have a separate webhook IP block).

Action items from Orchid:
- Provide tenancy users: priya.shah@orchidhealth.com and devops+orchid@orchidhealth.com (please invite both).
- CIDR list: see attached partial export (orchid-cidrs.txt). We'll finalize by EOD Friday (2027-06-18).
- Peering window: we have a 60-minute slot on 2027-06-26 10:00–11:00 PT — please let us know if Redwood can join.

We also asked security for an internal review of the MAP document; we'll flag any problematic items on the shared Drive.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Platform Engineer, Orchid Health

Attachment stub: orchid-cidrs.txt
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@orchidhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation preflight & MAP — action card & kickoff confirmation

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Priya. Summary and immediate asks before the peering window on 2027-06-26: 

1) Orchid to drop final CIDR export to the shared Drive link by 2027-06-18 COB (PRIORITY).
2) Orchid to confirm the two invite emails (Priya + devops+orchid) so Neha can provision the tenant by 2027-06-25.
3) Redwood (Marcus) to create the ephemeral service key on 2027-06-24 and post the rotation instructions to the MAP sheet.
4) Jonas to join the peering call on 2027-06-26 10:00 PT for validation; Hannah to host the call link.

If we hit these dates, we keep the 2027-06-28 POC kickoff. Otherwise we shift by one week.

I'll host the 2027-06-26 runbook call — calendar invite incoming.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference
